_meta.provenance: Rows are real titles/snippets copied from Argus archives (hermes-agent-updates, motherboard-sales, slug-voice-service). URLs are omitted: folding reads title + snippet only.
_meta.labeling: agent-starter — labels are defensible but NOT human-reviewed. Review and extend before treating the precision/recall table as authoritative.
_meta.semantics: A fix and its test are the SAME change. Two unrelated subsystems are DIFFERENT. Distinct releases of one project are DIFFERENT cards.

rows.title: fix: listing surfaces show the merged view for MCP servers named like built-in toolsets
rows.snippet: Route colliding names through get_toolset() so /toolsets and dashboard show union of built-in and MCP tools; document alias/collision behavior.

rows.title: fix(toolsets): merge MCP tools when alias collides with static toolset
rows.snippet: If an MCP server registers under the same name as a built-in toolset, merge both tool lists instead of silently shadowing MCP tools. Description annotated so source is visible in /toolsets info.

rows.title: fix: mid-turn user message no longer waits behind a foreground terminal command
rows.snippet: Redirect mid-turn messages now yield foreground commands to background sessions instead of blocking until exit; tool returns immediately with yielded_to_background + session_id.

rows.title: test(docker): atexit drain joins worker of env already popped from registry
rows.snippet: Regression test ensuring finished docker teardown workers do not accumulate across long gateway life.

rows.title: fix(docker): teardown workers of reaper-detached containers are drained at exit
rows.snippet: Records every teardown worker in module-level set and drains them at interpreter exit, fixing leftover containers after idle-reaper cleanup.

rows.title: fix(serve): Desktop-over-SSH isolated backends retire themselves when idle
rows.snippet: Idle isolated SSH backends exit after dashboard.ssh_isolated_idle_grace_s with no clients and no running turn; fixes WAL corruption from accumulated backend writers.

rows.title: test(docker): snap_compat drops only --init and no-new-privileges; key bridged on every config path
rows.snippet: Regression coverage for snap-compat docker option handling.

rows.title: feat(docker): terminal.docker_snap_compat opt-out for snap-packaged Docker
rows.snippet: Adds docker_snap_compat option to strip --init and --no-new-privileges for snap-packaged Docker environments.

rows.title: Docs site updated for Bot Mode, quick links, platform support
rows.snippet: Documentation highlights Bot Mode, MCP, memory, skills, voice mode, personality, security, and architecture. Install paths for Windows/macOS/Linux and quickstart are documented.

rows.title: test(file_sync): backend can reopen staging tar for writing; POSIX remote keys match on Windows host
rows.snippet: Tests covering Windows file sync fixes.

rows.title: fix(file_sync): Windows sync_back no longer drops remote edits
rows.snippet: Fixes exclusive-handle PermissionError on Windows and POSIX key matching by using mkstemp + as_posix keys.

rows.title: docs(skills): reddit-reading spells out that no login is needed and OAuth is app-only
rows.snippet: Clarifies default backend needs no Reddit account/login/cookie/API key; optional upgrade uses free script app registration with app-only client_credentials grant.

rows.title: fix(desktop): deny window-open side-effect opens (GHSA-9f4c-93c8-jc8g)
rows.snippet: Closes CVE-2026-70608 / GHSA-9f4c-93c8-jc8g with always-deny window-open handler; removes side-effect open in sandboxed iframe path.

rows.title: fix(desktop): harden window-open deny and cover the link-title window
rows.snippet: Deny-by-default window-open hardened against throwing observers; denied logs carry origin only; hidden link-title window covered.

rows.title: Main branch activity ahead of latest tag: subagent/goal/dispatch fixes on 2026-09-07
rows.snippet: Commits include docs on grouped delegation results; fix for task-first subagent completion notices in CLI/TUI; tests retaining CLI goal parity oracle; fix sharing goal controls while messaging turns active; refactor sharing CLI goal commands across surfaces; fix tolerating schema-valued type keys in watchdog payload estimator; fix recovering when plugin hook worker cannot start; fix tolerating legacy Kanban task attachment responses; gateway heartbeat admission fix; gpt-6 Astra Codex OAuth compaction autoraise; fix stale-call watchdog pricing images at per-image cost; fix stripping tool-result message name for strict providers; feat API call log carrying cache write count/response id/upstream.

rows.title: feat(compression): per-image token cost learned from provider usage
rows.snippet: Per-image token cost is now learned from provider usage instead of flat constants; fixes compaction misses on high-cost vision models. Stored in image_token_costs.json and propagated across estimators.

rows.title: fix(agent): stale-call watchdog prices images at learned per-image cost
rows.snippet: Stale-stream/non-stream watchdog and Codex TTFB floor estimator now use learned per-image cost instead of base64 length, avoiding 100K-token estimates for screenshots.

rows.title: fix(compaction): count api_content in tail budget
rows.snippet: Tail budget walk now counts api_content, preventing protected-tail underestimation after compaction triggers.
